{"note": "d03 Thu 06:09: counter_k1 held bowl_shared_1, lunchbox_mara, plate_shared_2; resident_1 present. Absence of mug_mara (0.35) and pen_mara (0.30) confirms they are not stable counter residents. Presence of lunchbox_mara (0.45) validates Kitchen Hub role. Shared dishes (bowl/plate) are the primary stable occupants of counter_k1 when resident is active.", "fork": {"beliefs": "BELIEFS: 
1. Kitchen Hub (counter_k1) is the primary stable location for shared dishes (bowl_shared_1, bowl_shared_2, plate_shared_1, plate_shared_2) and lunchbox_mara during resident activity. Why: d03 06:09 look confirmed bowl_shared_1, lunchbox_mara, plate_shared_2 present; resident_1 active. 
2. Personal transient items (mug_mara, pen_mara) are NOT stable on counter_k1. Why: d03 06:09 absence of mug_mara and pen_mara despite high prior probability; they are likely in hand or moved to sink/other rooms. 
3. Care Zone (bathroom_shelf_ba1) items (hairbrush_mara, medication_bottle_mara, makeup_kit_mara) are highly volatile and strongly correlated with resident presence. Why: d03 05:06 absence vs 05:57 presence with resident_1. 
4. Sleep Zone (nightstand_b1) is exclusive to phone_mara at night. Why: d03 05:59 look confirmed only phone_mara present. 
5. Transit Zone (entry_hook_e1) anchors backpack_mara; jacket_mara and charger_mara are less stable. Why: d03 05:50 look showed only backpack_mara; jacket/charger absent. 
6. Sink Zone (sink_k1) stores shared dishes and watering_can_mara. Why: d02/d03 observations. 
7. Cupboard (cupboard_k1) holds headphones_mara, mug_shared_1, pot_shared_1. Why: d02 confirmation. 
8. Towel (towel_mara) is stable on towel_rack_ba1. Why: d03 morning routine stability. 
9. Keys (keys_mara) are often ON_PERSON or misplaced, not reliably on entry_hook_e1. Why: d02 absence from hook. 
10. Bedroom floor (bedroom_floor_b1) is for bulky overflow. Why: baseline observation. 
11. Objects are sometimes misplaced or moved for no reason. Why: general household noise. 
12. Resident presence predicts activity in Care Zone and Kitchen Hub. Why: d03 correlation.", "why": "The look at counter_k1 contradicted the belief that mug_mara and pen_mara are stable on the counter (50% probability). Their absence, while shared dishes and lunchbox were present, indicates that personal transient items are not reliable counter residents. This requires a belief update to lower the probability of mug/pen on counter_k1 and emphasize shared dishes/lunchbox as the stable occupants."}}
